description: Test code for absl::Notification synchronization primitive, including thread coordination and notification behavior tests using Google Test framework.

classes.name: ThreadSafeCounter
classes.description: A thread-safe class that holds a counter with methods to increment, retrieve, and wait until the counter reaches a certain value.

methods.name: Increment
methods.description: Increments the internal counter in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the current value of the counter.

methods.name: WaitUntilGreaterOrEqual
methods.description: Blocks until the counter is greater than or equal to a specified value.
